title: 651. London’s Golden Age: Sex and Scandal in Georgian Britain (Part 2)

sentences.en: Sunday, 28th of November.
sentences.zh: 11月28日，星期日。

sentences.en: I breakfasted with Mr. Douglas.
sentences.zh: 我和道格拉斯先生共进早餐。

sentences.en: I went to St. James's Church and heard service and a good sermon on
sentences.zh: 我去了圣詹姆斯教堂，参加了礼拜，并听了一场精彩的布道，主题是

sentences.en: By What Means Shall a Young Man Learn to Order His Ways, in which the advantages of early piety were well displayed.
sentences.zh: 《年轻人当如何学会规范自己的行为》，其中对早期虔诚的益处阐述得淋漓尽致。

sentences.en: What a curious, inconsistent thing is the mind of man.
sentences.zh: 人类的心思真是奇妙而矛盾。

sentences.en: In the midst of divine service, I was laying plans for having women, and yet I had the most sincere feelings of religion.
sentences.zh: 在神圣的礼拜仪式中，我竟在盘算着如何找女人，然而我内心却有着最真诚的宗教情感。

sentences.en: So that was James Boswell writing in his journal six months before his fateful meeting with Samuel Johnson, the hero of this story, in Thomas Davies' bookshop.
sentences.zh: 以上就是詹姆斯·博斯韦尔在与本书主角塞缪尔·约翰逊于托马斯·戴维斯书店那次宿命般的会面六个月前，在日记中写下的内容。

sentences.en: So Boswell had begun this great journal, one of the most glittering, scintillating records of life in the 18th century ever written,
sentences.zh: 博斯韦尔开启了这部伟大的日记，这是有史以来关于18世纪生活最璀璨、最闪耀的记录之一，

sentences.en: arguably the most complete record of what it's like to live in the 18th century.
sentences.zh: 可以说，这是关于18世纪生活最完整的记录。

sentences.en: He'd begun this enormous project two weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 他在两周前才刚刚开始这项宏大的工程。

sentences.en: But who was this young man who was sitting in church, having all these fantasies about having women during the sermon of all moments?
sentences.zh: 但这个坐在教堂里，在布道时刻竟满脑子都是女人幻想的年轻人究竟是谁呢？

sentences.en: Shocking.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊。

sentences.en: Tom, tell all.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，快从实招来。

sentences.en: Well, as people will be able to tell from your accent, James Boswell is a young Scot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如大家从你的口音中听出的那样，詹姆斯·博斯韦尔是个年轻的苏格兰人。

sentences.en: He's 22 years old at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时他22岁。

sentences.en: He's stocky and built.
sentences.zh: 他身材敦实，体格健壮。

sentences.en: And there's a hint of fleshiness, I think, in his face, perhaps a precursor of how he will look in middle age.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他的脸上有一丝肉感，或许预示了他中年时的模样。

sentences.en: But he's very kind of mobile in expression.
sentences.zh: 但他的表情非常生动。

sentences.en: People always comment on this.
sentences.zh: 人们总是对此津津乐道。

sentences.en: And he has a face that many years later, a judge who had known him would describe as impossible to look upon without being moved by the comicality, which always reigned upon it.
sentences.zh: 多年后，一位认识他的法官曾形容，看着他的脸，很难不被那上面始终洋溢的滑稽感所打动。

sentences.en: He looks fun.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很有趣。

sentences.en: Not only does he look fun, but he is fun.
sentences.zh: 他不仅看起来有趣，而且确实是个有趣的人。

sentences.en: People like him very, very instinctively.
sentences.zh: 人们本能地非常喜欢他。

sentences.en: And he's just arrived in London when he put it down, that journal entry that you read, from Edinburgh.
sentences.zh: 当你读到那段日记时，他刚从爱丁堡抵达伦敦。

sentences.en: And honestly, he couldn't be more thrilled about it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，他对此感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: So the journey from Edinburgh down to London had taken him three days.
sentences.zh: 从爱丁堡到伦敦的旅程花了他三天时间。

sentences.en: It had been quite brutal.
sentences.zh: 过程相当艰苦。

sentences.en: They'd kind of lost a wheel outside Berwick and so on.
sentences.zh: 他们在贝里克外还掉了一个轮子之类的。

sentences.en: And so when they arrive, Boswell, well, he writes in his journal, when we came upon Highgate Hill and had a view of London, I was all life and joy.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们抵达时，博斯韦尔在日记中写道：当我们来到海格特山，俯瞰伦敦时，我感到浑身充满了生机与喜悦。

sentences.en: And he had given three hussars.
sentences.zh: 他还高呼了三声万岁。

sentences.en: Oh, lovely.
sentences.zh: 哦，真可爱。

sentences.en: We love a man who gives three hussars when he's happy, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，我们都喜欢那种在快乐时会高呼三声万岁的人。

sentences.en: So just to remind people what this story is, it's the story of Samuel Johnson and James Boswell.
sentences.zh: 为了提醒大家这个故事的内容，这是关于塞缪尔·约翰逊和詹姆斯·博斯韦尔的故事。

sentences.en: It's a brilliant window into friendship,
sentences.zh: 这是一扇洞察友谊的绝佳窗口，

sentences.en: into 18th century London, into 18th century Britain, this country that at this point is teeming with life and energy and excitement.
sentences.zh: 也是了解18世纪伦敦和英国的窗口，这个国家在当时充满了生机、活力和激情。

sentences.en: It is becoming the most modern and the most powerful country in the world.
sentences.zh: 它正在成为世界上最现代、最强大的国家。

sentences.en: And we're using their story as a way into telling that story.
sentences.zh: 我们正通过他们的故事来讲述那个时代的故事。

sentences.en: So actually, London, he's giving the three hussars, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，伦敦，他高呼了三声万岁，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because London to Boswell represents the promised land.
sentences.zh: 因为对博斯韦尔来说，伦敦代表着应许之地。

sentences.en: It's everything he's ever hoped for.
sentences.zh: 这是他一直以来梦寐以求的一切。

sentences.en: Yeah, so it offers him glamour, and Boswell loves glamour.
sentences.zh: 是的，它带给他魅力，而博斯韦尔热爱魅力。

sentences.en: So he takes rooms in the very centre of things, in Downing Street, where the Prime Minister lives now.
sentences.zh: 所以他在市中心，也就是现在首相居住的唐宁街附近租了房。

sentences.en: But he's using it as a base for all kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 但他把这里当作各种活动的基地。

sentences.en: So he's using it as a base for shopping.
sentences.zh: 他把它当作购物的基地。

sentences.en: He goes out and buys what he describes as a genteel, violet-coloured frock suit.
sentences.zh: 他出去买了一套他形容为“体面的紫罗兰色礼服”。

sentences.en: So he loves clothes.
sentences.zh: 他很爱打扮。

sentences.en: He meets lots of celebrities.
sentences.zh: 他结识了许多名人。

sentences.en: We said in the previous episode how Boswell is a great celebrity hunter.
sentences.zh: 我们在上一集说过，博斯韦尔是个狂热的名人猎手。

sentences.en: So he's hanging out with actors and poets and politicians and lords and all kinds of people like that.
sentences.zh: 所以他经常和演员、诗人、政客、贵族以及各种各样的人混在一起。

sentences.en: And he goes to lots of exclusive clubs.
sentences.zh: 他还去了许多高级俱乐部。

sentences.en: And of course, the 18th century loves a club.
sentences.zh: 当然，18世纪的人们非常喜欢俱乐部。

sentences.en: And he goes to one, the Beefsteak Club.
sentences.zh: 他去了一个叫“牛排俱乐部”的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We had nothing to eat but beefsteaks and had wine and punch in plenty and freedom.
sentences.zh: 我们除了牛排什么也没吃，但有充足的葡萄酒、潘趣酒和自由。

sentences.en: We had a number of songs.
sentences.zh: 我们还唱了许多歌。

sentences.en: So it's very like the Rest is History Club, which people, if they're interested, they can head to therestishistory.com to sign up.
sentences.zh: 这很像“历史余味”俱乐部，如果大家感兴趣，可以去therestishistory.com报名。

sentences.en: And they will get similar quantities of beefsteaks and songs, especially at the Rest is History Festival, which is this July at Hampton Court Palace.
sentences.zh: 他们也能享受到同样数量的牛排和歌曲，特别是在今年七月于汉普顿宫举办的“历史余味”节上。

sentences.en: That is so expertly done.
sentences.zh: 这说得太专业了。

sentences.en: But Dominic, just to go back to the history, you did an episode on beefsteak, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 但多米尼克，回到历史，你之前做过一期关于牛排的节目，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, Beef and Liberty.
sentences.zh: 是的，《牛肉与自由》。

sentences.en: So this is the kind of the dimension of London that Boswell, although a Scot, is very enthusiastically entering this notion of England as a home of liberty.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是伦敦的那个层面，博斯韦尔虽然是苏格兰人，却非常热衷于融入这种将英国视为自由之乡的观念。

sentences.en: London also represents to Boswell a sense of escape and opportunity.
sentences.zh: 对博斯韦尔来说，伦敦也代表着一种逃离和机遇。

sentences.en: So he's just up in Edinburgh.
sentences.zh: 他刚从爱丁堡上来。

sentences.en: His father is a law lord, very determined that Boswell is going to become a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是一位法官，非常坚决地要求博斯韦尔成为一名律师。

sentences.en: Boswell has scraped through his law examinations, but he's come to London basically because he's hoping for a much more glamorous career.
sentences.zh: 博斯韦尔勉强通过了法律考试，但他来伦敦主要是因为他渴望一份更光鲜的职业。

sentences.en: Namely, he wants to enter the guards and kind of tazz around London in a bright red coat and all of that.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他想加入卫队，穿着鲜红的制服在伦敦招摇过市之类的。

sentences.en: That's also a crucial part of what has brought him to the capital.
sentences.zh: 这也是促使他来到首都的一个关键原因。

sentences.en: But there is another aspect as well, which was hinted at, well, more than hinted at, I mean, he's absolutely drawing attention to it in that sermon.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一个方面，之前已经暗示过，不，不仅仅是暗示，我的意思是，他在那篇布道中完全是在强调这一点。

sentences.en: And this is what Boswell elsewhere in his journal describes as the wars of the Paffian Queen, by which he essentially means having lots of sex.
sentences.zh: 这就是博斯韦尔在日记其他地方所描述的“帕菲亚女王的战争”，他本质上是指频繁的性行为。

sentences.en: So the Paffian Queen is Venus.
sentences.zh: 所以帕菲亚女王就是维纳斯。

sentences.en: And Boswell in particular has a kind of, one could describe it perhaps as a bent for prostitutes.
sentences.zh: 博斯韦尔本人有一种，或许可以形容为对妓女的癖好。

sentences.en: London, of course, at this point has multitudes of prostitutes.
sentences.zh: 当然，当时的伦敦有大量的妓女。

sentences.en: Many of them are disease ridden.
sentences.zh: 她们中许多人身患疾病。

sentences.en: And Boswell himself has already, as a result of this, caught the clap.
sentences.zh: 而博斯韦尔本人也因此已经染上了淋病。

sentences.en: A gonorrhea, yeah.
sentences.zh: 也就是淋病，没错。

sentences.en: And so he's nervous about getting it again.
sentences.zh: 所以他很担心再次染病。

sentences.en: And in the early weeks of his arrival in London, he's actually incredibly impressed with what he describes as his own wonderful continents.
sentences.zh: 在他抵达伦敦的最初几周，他实际上对自己所描述的“美妙的节制”感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: On the 14th of December, just a month or so after his arrival in London,
sentences.zh: 12月14日，也就是他抵达伦敦一个月左右后，

sentences.en: It is very curious to think that I have now been in London several weeks without ever enjoying the delightful sex,
sentences.zh: 想到我已经在伦敦待了几周，却从未享受过那美妙的性爱，真是太奇怪了，

sentences.en: although I am surrounded with numbers of free-hearted ladies of all kinds, from the splendid madam at 50 guineas a night,
sentences.zh: 尽管我身边环绕着无数随性的女士，从每晚50几尼的华丽名妓，

sentences.en: down to the civil nymph with white thread stockings who tramps along the strand and will resign her engaging person to your honour for a pint of wine and a shilling.
sentences.zh: 到穿着白线长袜、在海滨大道上游荡、只需一杯葡萄酒和一先令就能向你献身的平民仙女，应有尽有。

sentences.en: I feel like the pint of wine element would be off-putting for me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得“一杯葡萄酒”这个条件会让我退避三舍。

sentences.en: I feel like somebody who's advertising their wares for a pint of wine is poor on all sides.
sentences.zh: 我觉得用一杯葡萄酒来兜售自己的人，无论从哪方面看都很可怜。

sentences.en: I mean, I think the point is that Boswell is willing to go with whatever class of prostitute he can pick up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，重点在于博斯韦尔愿意和任何阶层的妓女发生关系。

sentences.en: So this makes Boswell sound a very bad man.
sentences.zh: 这让博斯韦尔听起来像个坏人。

sentences.en: However, he is simultaneously desperate for moral guidance.
sentences.zh: 然而，他同时又极度渴望道德指引。

sentences.en: I mean, he's fantasizing about women in church, but he is in church.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在教堂里幻想女人，但他确实是在教堂里。

sentences.en: And what he really wants, I think, is someone to put him on the straight and narrow.
sentences.zh: 我想他真正想要的是有人能让他走上正道。

sentences.en: Oh, he just wants to be loved.
sentences.zh: 哦，他只是想被爱。

sentences.en: So he is, as his journal makes clear, a compound of contradictions and incompatibilities.
sentences.zh: 正如他的日记所表明的那样，他是一个矛盾和不相容的集合体。

sentences.en: And he traces these incompatibilities right the way through his journal.
sentences.zh: 他在日记中始终在追溯这些不相容之处。

sentences.en: So he's a very open, gregarious, friendly man.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常开朗、合群、友善的人。

sentences.en: But at the same time, he's very prone to deep melancholy.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他非常容易陷入深深的忧郁。

sentences.en: He's very bumptious and self-regarding.
sentences.zh: 他非常自负且自视甚高。

sentences.en: So he's always making comments in his journal, like, I am one of the most engaging men that ever lived, and clearly means it.
sentences.zh: 所以他总是在日记里写下诸如“我是有史以来最迷人的人之一”之类的话，而且显然是认真的。

sentences.en: But he's also very lacking in self-confidence.
sentences.zh: 但他又非常缺乏自信。

sentences.en: And as we've said, he's a prodigious womanizer, but he is looking to reform himself.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，他是个惊人的花花公子，但他又在寻求自我改造。

sentences.en: And this, I think, is a crucial part of his fascination with great men, which will be a theme of this episode.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这是他痴迷于伟人的关键部分，这也将成为本集的主题。

sentences.en: So it's not just that he's a celebrity hunter.
sentences.zh: 所以他不仅仅是个名人猎手。

sentences.en: It's more than that.
sentences.zh: 远不止于此。

sentences.en: He is looking for someone who can serve him as a mentor, as a kind of moral sheet anchor, if you like.
sentences.zh: 他在寻找一个能担任他导师的人，一个可以作为他道德支柱的人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Stopping him from drifting and straying all over the place.
sentences.zh: 让他不再随波逐流。

sentences.en: And the person that he has long cast in that role is Samuel Johnson, who we talked about in the last episode,
sentences.zh: 而他长期以来选定的角色人选就是塞缪尔·约翰逊，我们在上一集谈到过他，

sentences.en: the great polymath man of letters from Litchfield in the West Midlands.
sentences.zh: 那位来自西米德兰兹郡利奇菲尔德的博学文人。

sentences.en: And Boswell has looked up to him since he was a child.
sentences.zh: 博斯韦尔从孩提时代起就一直仰慕他。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So his father, who we will find out, doesn't really approve of Johnson, nevertheless had copies of his moral essays in his library.
sentences.zh: 所以他的父亲，我们稍后会发现，虽然并不真正赞同约翰逊，但他的书架上却收藏着约翰逊的道德散文集。

sentences.en: And Boswell had read them, and they had given him this kind of idea of London as the home of this tremendous sage.
sentences.zh: 博斯韦尔读过这些文章，它们让他产生了一种伦敦是这位伟大圣贤故乡的印象。

sentences.en: And so I think that is also part of why Boswell has come to London.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这也是博斯韦尔来到伦敦的部分原因。

sentences.en: He has this fantasy that, in a sense, Johnson can provide him with the kind of father figure that his own father doesn't.
sentences.zh: 他有一种幻想，即在某种意义上，约翰逊能提供他父亲无法给予他的那种父亲形象。

sentences.en: Because his father, Lord Affleck, this Scottish law lord, is a very intimidating man.
sentences.zh: 因为他的父亲，阿弗莱克勋爵，这位苏格兰法官，是一个非常令人生畏的人。

sentences.en: And he's actually the opposite to Johnson.
sentences.zh: 而且他实际上与约翰逊截然相反。

sentences.en: He doesn't really have much time for kind of literary men, which Johnson is.
sentences.zh: 他并不怎么看得起像约翰逊那样的文人。

sentences.en: Lord Affleck is a Whig, and Johnson is a Tory.
sentences.zh: 阿弗莱克勋爵是辉格党人，而约翰逊是托利党人。

sentences.en: Lord Affleck is a Presbyterian, and Johnson is an Anglican.
sentences.zh: 阿弗莱克勋爵是长老会教徒，而约翰逊是圣公会教徒。

sentences.en: And so there's a sense, I think, that Boswell coming to London, it's an overt act of rebellion against his father, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，博斯韦尔来到伦敦，实际上是对他父亲的一种公开反叛。

sentences.en: I mean, he's proud of his, you know, his father, his lineage, all that kind of thing, isn't he, Boswell?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他为他的父亲、他的血统以及所有这些感到自豪，不是吗，博斯韦尔？

sentences.en: He's not completely rebelling against the Boswells.
sentences.zh: 他并没有完全背叛博斯韦尔家族。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I mean, just the opposite.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，恰恰相反。

sentences.en: And this is another way in which Boswell is such a complicated man.
sentences.zh: 这也是博斯韦尔如此复杂的原因之一。

sentences.en: Even as he's coming to London looking for a father figure, he remains incredibly proud of his father, and inordinately proud of the entire Boswell name, as you suggeSt.
sentences.zh: 即使他在伦敦寻找父亲形象时，他依然对自己的父亲感到无比自豪，并如你所暗示的那样，对整个博斯韦尔家族的名字感到异常骄傲。

sentences.en: So the Boswells are an ancient noble family.
sentences.zh: 博斯韦尔家族是一个古老的贵族世家。

sentences.en: Boswell has a forefather who had died for the Scottish king at Flodden.
sentences.zh: 博斯韦尔有一位祖先曾在弗洛登战役中为苏格兰国王捐躯。

sentences.en: And he has a mother who, in a very tangential sense that Boswell is always harping upon, has a kind of relationship, a distant relationship to the Scottish monarchy.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲，用博斯韦尔总是挂在嘴边的一种非常牵强的说法，与苏格兰王室有着某种遥远的亲缘关系。

sentences.en: And he is particularly sentimental about the ancestral seat of the Boswells, which is this place Affleck,
sentences.zh: 他对自己家族的祖宅——阿弗莱克，有着特别的情怀，

sentences.en: which I'd always thought it was pronounced as it's spelt, Auchinleck, but apparently it is Affleck.
sentences.zh: 我一直以为它的发音和拼写一样是“奥金莱克”，但显然是“阿弗莱克”。

sentences.en: And this is set south of Glasgow, the rolling green hills of Ayrshire, north of Dumfries.
sentences.zh: 它位于格拉斯哥南部，艾尔郡起伏的绿色山丘中，邓弗里斯以北。

sentences.en: And it has this tremendously romantic keep on a kind of gorge above the meeting place of two rivers.
sentences.zh: 那里有一座非常浪漫的城堡，坐落在两条河流交汇处的峡谷之上。

sentences.en: And even though Lord Affleck has just completed a very kind of fancy classical mansion,
sentences.zh: 尽管阿弗莱克勋爵刚刚建成了一座非常华丽的古典宅邸，

sentences.en: which is still standing there to this day, Boswell's heart is always going to be lying with the ruins.
sentences.zh: 至今仍矗立在那里，但博斯韦尔的心始终属于那些废墟。

sentences.en: I felt a classic enthusiasm in the romantic shades of our family's seat.
sentences.zh: 我在家族祖宅的浪漫阴影中感受到了古典的热情。

sentences.en: So Boswell is kind of, he's a snob, but he's a romantic snob.
sentences.zh: 所以博斯韦尔算是一个势利小人，但却是一个浪漫的势利小人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So he's born in 1740.
sentences.zh: 他出生于1740年。

sentences.en: So, you know, he's one of the first generations, I guess, to be really infused with the spirit of romanticism in some ways,
sentences.zh: 所以，我想他是第一代在某种程度上真正受到浪漫主义精神熏陶的人，

sentences.en: that kind of nostalgic kind of sentimentality when you're looking at old ruins and all of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 那种在凝视古老废墟时产生的怀旧感伤。

sentences.en: Which his father absolutely is not.
sentences.zh: 而他的父亲绝对不是这样。

sentences.en: His father does not approve of people who have, you know, lively imaginations and romantic leanings, or indeed Toryism.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲不赞同那些拥有活跃想象力和浪漫倾向的人，也不赞同托利党主义。

sentences.en: And Lord Affleck is just unbelievably impatient with what he sees as his son's frivolity.
sentences.zh: 阿弗莱克勋爵对他儿子所谓的轻浮行为感到极其不耐烦。

sentences.en: So Boswell, we've said he's gregarious.
sentences.zh: 所以博斯韦尔，我们说过他很合群。

sentences.en: Lord Affleck thinks he's much too gregarious, that he talks too much, that he laughs too loudly, that he's a show-off.
sentences.zh: 阿弗莱克勋爵认为他太合群了，说话太多，笑声太大，是个爱炫耀的人。

sentences.en: Lord Affleck, I'm afraid to say, is not a fan of impersonations and impressions.
sentences.zh: 恐怕阿弗莱克勋爵并不喜欢模仿和表演。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: The lowest and meanest kind of wit.
sentences.zh: 那是最低级、最卑劣的机智。

sentences.en: Yeah, terrible.
sentences.zh: 是的，太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And obviously Lord Affleck is not amused by the fact that Boswell is already in debt, that he's having all these affairs, that he's having these periodic doses of the clap.
sentences.zh: 显然，阿弗莱克勋爵对博斯韦尔已经负债累累、到处风流、还时不时染上淋病的事实感到非常不满。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is not going down at all well with the Presbyterian law lord.
sentences.zh: 这位长老会的法官对此一点也高兴不起来。

sentences.en: And so you can see, I think, why Boswell, even if he loves his father and admires him, might be looking around for someone slightly less challenging, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你能明白，为什么鲍斯威尔即使爱戴并敬仰他的父亲，也可能会想要寻找一个挑战性稍微小一点的人。

sentences.en: Although actually the man he ends up with is also going to prove quite challenging.
sentences.zh: 尽管实际上他最终找的那个人也证明是相当具有挑战性的。

sentences.en: Pretty challenging if he's going to twitch at you.
sentences.zh: 如果他还要对你抽搐的话，那可真是够呛。

sentences.en: So the person he's got his heart set on is Samuel Johnson, who is obviously the opposite of his father in every way.
sentences.zh: 所以他一心想要追求的人是塞缪尔·约翰逊，他在各方面显然都与他的父亲截然相反。

sentences.en: He's kind of warm and, well, he's warm in his own way, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 他很热情，嗯，我想他有他自己那种热情的方式。

sentences.en: But he's a character, shall we say.
sentences.zh: 但我们得说，他是个很有个性的人。

sentences.en: But for the time being, Boswell puts his energies into, what does he call it?
sentences.zh: 但目前为止，鲍斯威尔把精力都投入到了——他管这叫什么来着？

sentences.en: The Wars of the Papian Queen.
sentences.zh: 《帕皮安女王之战》。

sentences.en: He does.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because he's been abstemious for the first few weeks, but eventually his resistance collapses.
sentences.zh: 因为他在最初的几周里一直很节制，但最终他的抵抗力崩溃了。

sentences.en: And he becomes particularly interested in an actress at the Covent Garden Theatre, and he gives her the pseudonym of Louisa.
sentences.zh: 他开始对考文特花园剧院的一位女演员特别感兴趣，并给她取了个化名，叫路易莎。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the point about Louisa is that she's the daughter of quite well-born parents.
sentences.zh: 关于路易莎，重点在于她是出身名门的女儿。

sentences.en: And so Boswell assumes that not, you know, I mean, her beauty is obviously very important to him.
sentences.zh: 所以鲍斯威尔认为，你知道，我的意思是，她的美貌对他来说显然非常重要。

sentences.en: But so also is the very strong probability that she won't have gonorrhea.
sentences.zh: 但同样重要的是，她不太可能患有淋病。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He thinks, I'm going to play it safe.
sentences.zh: 他想，我要稳妥行事。

sentences.en: I'm not going to go, you know, roaming around the streets.
sentences.zh: 我不会去，你知道，在街上到处游荡。

sentences.en: I'm going to stick with this beautiful actress.
sentences.zh: 我要和这位漂亮的女演员在一起。

sentences.en: Sensible from him, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他这样做很明智。

sentences.en: It's the first great tour de force in his journal, his account of this relationship with Louisa.
sentences.zh: 这是他日记中第一个伟大的杰作，即他与路易莎这段关系的记录。

sentences.en: It reads like a kind of mad novel, and it's kind of variously erotic, but also full of completely mortifying behavior on the part of Boswell, all of which he details.
sentences.zh: 读起来像是一部疯狂的小说，既有各种情色意味，又充满了鲍斯威尔令人尴尬的行为，而他将这一切都详细记录了下来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Without any sense of kind of inhibition at all.
sentences.zh: 完全没有任何顾忌。

sentences.en: And I think it's worth looking at in some detail, because it gives you a real sense, not just of Boswell's character, but of his kind of genius as a writer of journals.
sentences.zh: 我认为这非常值得详细研究，因为它让你不仅能感受到鲍斯威尔的性格，还能感受到他作为日记作者的天赋。

sentences.en: So he's met up with Louisa and in due course, he is admitted into her rooms and he finds her, as he describes it, in a pleasing undress.
sentences.zh: 于是他见到了路易莎，不久后，他被允许进入她的房间，正如他所描述的那样，他发现她穿着令人愉悦的便装。

sentences.en: At this point, both of them are kind of pretending to be shy, but both commit to future meetings.
sentences.zh: 此时，他们两人都在假装害羞，但都承诺了未来的会面。

sentences.en: And so Boswell duly comes back, they sit down and they have a very titillating discussion about the different ways in which English and French men pursue amorous escapades.
sentences.zh: 于是鲍斯威尔如约而至，他们坐下来，进行了一场非常撩人的讨论，谈论英国男人和法国男人追求风流韵事的不同方式。

sentences.en: And of course, now it's starting to get a bit more titillating.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在开始变得更加撩人了。

sentences.en: Yeah, a bit spicy.
sentences.zh: 是啊，有点刺激。

sentences.en: But it's still a kind of protracted courtship.
sentences.zh: 但这仍然是一种旷日持久的求爱。

sentences.en: You know, there are more meetings.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还有更多的会面。

sentences.en: But Boswell makes certain at their next meeting, as he puts it, to inform her by my looks of my passion for her.
sentences.zh: 但鲍斯威尔在下一次会面时确保，正如他所说，用我的眼神向她传达我对她的热情。

sentences.en: And I don't quite know what that would mean.
sentences.zh: 我不太明白那意味着什么。

sentences.en: He looks at her in a smoldering way.
sentences.zh: 他用一种炽热的眼神看着她。

sentences.en: If you know how to do it, you know how to do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道怎么做，你就知道怎么做。

sentences.en: Tom, what can I say?
sentences.zh: 汤姆，我能说什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So the visits continue and on one of them, Boswell suddenly feels what he describes as the fine delirium of love.
sentences.zh: 所以会面继续进行，在其中一次会面中，鲍斯威尔突然感受到了他所描述的“爱情的美妙谵妄”。

sentences.en: So he is, he's now absolutely committed.
sentences.zh: 所以他现在是彻底投入了。

sentences.en: And on his next meeting, Louisa says, look, I'm a bit skint.
sentences.zh: 在下一次会面时，路易莎说，听着，我手头有点紧。

sentences.en: Would you lend me two guineas?
sentences.zh: 你能借我两个几尼吗？

sentences.en: Okay, that's a red flag for me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这对我来说是个危险信号。

sentences.en: And Boswell, feeling very gallant, does so.
sentences.zh: 而鲍斯威尔表现得非常大方，照做了。

sentences.en: And then the next time he kisses her with great warmth.
sentences.zh: 然后下一次，他非常热情地吻了她。

sentences.en: She received this very genteely.
sentences.zh: 她非常得体地接受了这一点。

sentences.en: I had a delicacy in presuming too far, lest it should look like demanding goods for my money.
sentences.zh: 我有一种顾虑，不敢太过分，以免看起来像是在用钱买欢。

sentences.en: I resumed the subject of love.
sentences.zh: 我重新谈起了爱情的话题。

sentences.en: So there's a certain caginess there.
sentences.zh: 所以这里面有一种谨慎。

sentences.en: Louisa doesn't want to seem like, you know, she's selling herself.
sentences.zh: 路易莎不想看起来像是在出卖自己。

sentences.en: And Boswell doesn't want to look like that's what he thinks she's doing.
sentences.zh: 而鲍斯威尔也不想看起来像是认为她在做那种事。

sentences.en: But at this point, they agree to meet in two days' time where the affair will be consummated.
sentences.zh: 但在这一点上，他们同意两天后见面，届时这段关系将会有实质性进展。

sentences.en: And so Boswell arrives full of excitement, but then, disaster.
sentences.zh: 于是鲍斯威尔满怀兴奋地赶来，但随后，灾难发生了。

sentences.en: I felt the tormenting anxiety of serious love.
sentences.zh: 我感受到了严肃爱情带来的折磨人的焦虑。

sentences.en: He can't perform.
sentences.zh: 他不行了。

sentences.en: Oh, no way.
sentences.zh: 哦，不会吧。

sentences.en: So he sits down beside her in despair.
sentences.zh: 于是他绝望地坐在她身边。

sentences.en: I would have given a good deal to be out of the room.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿付出很多代价也要离开那个房间。

sentences.en: And he gets up to go.
sentences.zh: 他起身准备离开。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And he's about to leave.
sentences.zh: 他正要走。

sentences.en: Then suddenly, saluting her with warmth, my powers were excited.
sentences.zh: 然后突然，热情地向她致意，我的力量被激发了。

sentences.en: I felt myself vigorous.
sentences.zh: 我感到自己精力充沛。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's become more Scottish as he's become more excited, which is interesting.
sentences.zh: 他变得越兴奋就越像个苏格兰人，这很有趣。

sentences.en: She's smart.
sentences.zh: 她很聪明。

sentences.en: She plays him along.
sentences.zh: 她一直在吊着他。

sentences.en: You know, she's still not surrendering to him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她还是没有向他屈服。

sentences.en: And she tells him, such a thing requires time to consider of.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，这种事情需要时间考虑。

sentences.en: And Boswell, of course, you know, she knows exactly what she's doing.
sentences.zh: 而鲍斯威尔，当然，你知道，她完全知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: Boswell is now, he finds himself really violently in love with Louisa.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯威尔现在发现自己真的疯狂地爱上了路易莎。

sentences.en: And the climax of this affair arrives at last on the 12th of January.
sentences.zh: 这段恋情的高潮终于在1月12日到来了。

sentences.en: Boswell's had a three-week courtship.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯威尔经历了三周的求爱。

sentences.en: And it's a long and very voluptuous night.
sentences.zh: 那是一个漫长而极其销魂的夜晚。

sentences.en: Five times was I fairly lost in Supreme Rapture.
sentences.zh: 我五次完全沉浸在至高无上的狂喜之中。

sentences.en: And there's a lot more of that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 还有很多类似的事情。

sentences.en: And then the next morning, I love this.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天早上，我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: I patrolled up and down Fleet Street, thinking on London, the seat of parliament and the seat of pleasure, and seeming to myself as one of the wits in King Charles II's time.
sentences.zh: 我在弗利特街走来走去，思考着伦敦，这个议会所在地和享乐中心，觉得自己就像查理二世时代的那些才子之一。

sentences.en: So he's imagining himself as a restoration rake.
sentences.zh: 所以他把自己想象成一个复辟时期的浪子。

sentences.en: And it's so Boswell that he's always kind of watching himself playing out roles.
sentences.zh: 这太鲍斯威尔了，他总是像在观察自己扮演角色一样。

sentences.en: There's a sense in which the journal is operating on two levels.
sentences.zh: 某种意义上，这本日记在两个层面上运作。

sentences.en: There's what Boswell is doing.
sentences.zh: 一个是鲍斯威尔正在做的事情。

sentences.en: And then there's Boswell watching himself, often in a state of kind of wonder how brilliant he is.
sentences.zh: 另一个是鲍斯威尔在观察自己，通常处于一种对自己有多天才的惊叹状态。

sentences.en: It's slightly disappointingly for Boswell, despite the five moments of rapture.
sentences.zh: 对鲍斯威尔来说，尽管有那五次狂喜时刻，结果还是有点令人失望。

sentences.en: And almost immediately, he decides that actually he's a bit sick of Louisa.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，他决定其实他有点厌倦路易莎了。

sentences.en: I observed an affectation about her, which disgusted me.
sentences.zh: 我观察到她有一种做作，这让我感到厌恶。

sentences.en: That's strong.
sentences.zh: 这话说得够重的。

sentences.en: After all that, geez.
sentences.zh: 经历了这一切之后，天哪。

sentences.en: I mean, again, you get the kind of the classic sense that the chase was all.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你再次得到了那种经典的感悟，即追求的过程就是一切。

sentences.en: And now he's caught his quarry.
sentences.zh: 现在他抓住了猎物。

sentences.en: He's not as interested.
sentences.zh: 他没那么感兴趣了。

sentences.en: But the fact goes on until then.
sentences.zh: 但事情一直持续到那时。

sentences.en: On the 20th of January, there is a disaster because he's been feeling a kind of pain in his nether regions and he goes to the doctor and he's diagnosed with that distemper with
sentences.zh: 1月20日，发生了一场灾难，因为他一直感到下体有一种疼痛，他去看医生，被诊断出患上了那种维纳斯在愤怒时，

sentences.en: which Venus, when cross, takes it into her head to plague her votaries.
sentences.zh: 心血来潮用来折磨她信徒的疾病。

sentences.en: He's got the clap.
sentences.zh: 他得了淋病。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Louisa's let herself down.
sentences.zh: 路易莎让他失望了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And so he goes to Louisa and she says, oh, no, no, no, no, no, I'm not infected.
sentences.zh: 于是他去找路易莎，她说，哦，不，不，不，不，我没有被感染。

sentences.en: I promise.
sentences.zh: 我保证。

sentences.en: And then she finally says, well, I did have it three years ago, but I'm completely cured.
sentences.zh: 然后她终于说，好吧，我三年前确实得过，但我已经完全治愈了。

sentences.en: And Boswell is furious, but he then tells her, look, I'm not going to blacken your name by this and he feels so pleased with himself for doing this.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯威尔很愤怒，但他随后告诉她，听着，我不会因此抹黑你的名声，他对自己这样做感到非常满意。

sentences.en: During all this conversation, I really behaved with a manly composure and polite dignity that could not fail to inspire an awe.
sentences.zh: 在整个谈话过程中，我表现得非常从容，带着一种令人敬畏的绅士尊严。

sentences.en: Well, that's good from him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他这一点做得不错。

sentences.en: But the next thing that happens, however, slightly undermines that.
sentences.zh: 然而，接下来发生的事情稍微削弱了这一点。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: So he's incredibly pleased with his kind of moral forbearance when he's with Louisa, but he then goes away and he starts to fulminate about it and get more and more irate.
sentences.zh: 所以他对自己与路易莎在一起时的那种道德克制感到非常满意，但他随后离开，开始对此大发雷霆，变得越来越愤怒。

sentences.en: And then he starts thinking, I lent her two guineas.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始想，我借给她两个几尼。

sentences.en: She's got the guineas.
sentences.zh: 她拿了那几个几尼。

sentences.en: I want my guineas back.
sentences.zh: 我要把我的几尼要回来。

sentences.en: And so he writes her this incredibly priggish letter, send the money sealed up.
sentences.zh: 于是他写了一封极其道貌岸然的信给她，把钱密封好寄过来。

sentences.en: I have nothing more to say to you.
sentences.zh: 我没什么可对你说的了。

sentences.en: And Louisa then returns it.
sentences.zh: 然后路易莎把它退了回来。

sentences.en: She had genuinely borrowed it.
sentences.zh: 她是真的借了钱。

sentences.en: And so all Boswell's darkest thoughts are shown to be false.
sentences.zh: 于是鲍斯威尔所有最阴暗的想法都被证明是错误的。

sentences.en: And he is briefly mortified.
sentences.zh: 他短暂地感到羞愧。

sentences.en: I felt a strange kind of mixed confusion.
sentences.zh: 我感到一种奇怪的混合困惑。

sentences.en: My tender heart relented.
sentences.zh: 我温柔的心软了下来。

sentences.en: I thought I had acted too harshly with her.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我对待她太苛刻了。

sentences.en: And so he's feeling ashamed.
sentences.zh: 所以他感到羞愧。

sentences.en: But then the next day he mentions the whole story to a friend.
sentences.zh: 但第二天，他向一位朋友提起了整个故事。

sentences.en: He said it was just a piece of deep artifice in her.
sentences.zh: 他说这只是她的一种深层诡计。

sentences.en: I resolved to think no more on the matter and was glad that I had come off two guineas better than I expected.
sentences.zh: 我决定不再想这件事，并庆幸自己比预期的多省下了两个几尼。

sentences.en: I mean, to be fair to Louisa, she did give him the money back.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，公平地说，路易莎确实把钱还给了他。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I don't think she comes out badly from this story, particularly.
sentences.zh: 我不认为她在这个故事中表现得很糟糕，特别地。

sentences.en: No, but I mean, her gesture had made Boswell feel bad about himself.
sentences.zh: 不，但我的意思是，她的举动让鲍斯威尔对自己感觉很不好。

sentences.en: And so he's now looking for reasons not to feel bad about himself.
sentences.zh: 所以他现在在寻找理由让自己感觉好受些。

sentences.en: And he finds one.
sentences.zh: 他找到了一个。

sentences.en: And what's incredible about this is that he writes it all down in incredible detail so that we, two and a half centuries on, can exactly track the appalling way, an incredibly
sentences.zh: 令人难以置信的是，他把这一切都极其详细地写了下来，以便我们两个半世纪后的人，能够准确地追踪他以一种极其人性化的方式，

sentences.en: human way in which he's responded to the whole shenanigans.
sentences.zh: 对整场闹剧做出的反应。

sentences.en: So this was in January, all this.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都发生在1月。

sentences.en: And the months have passed, or the weeks have passed.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了，或者说几周过去了。

sentences.en: And he's been feeling increasingly miserable, no doubt, because of the after effects of the gonorrhea as much as anything.
sentences.zh: 他无疑感到越来越痛苦，因为淋病的后遗症和其他任何事情一样严重。

sentences.en: So he's actually just got sick of London, hasn't he?
sentences.zh: 所以他其实只是厌倦了伦敦，不是吗？

sentences.en: He thought London was brilliant and now he's changed his mind.
sentences.zh: 他曾认为伦敦很棒，现在他改变了主意。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And what always happens with Boswell when he's depressed is that he basically goes on a kind of spree.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯威尔抑郁时总是会发生这种情况，他基本上会去疯狂放纵一番。

sentences.en: He surrenders to what he calls the foul fiend of the genitals.
sentences.zh: 他屈服于他所谓的“生殖器的邪恶魔鬼”。

sentences.en: That is a foul fiend, yeah.
sentences.zh: 那确实是个邪恶的魔鬼，是的。

sentences.en: And he's been walled up in his room, you know, getting over his gonorrhea.
sentences.zh: 他一直被关在房间里，你知道，在治愈他的淋病。

sentences.en: Now he's come out and he's determined not to get it again.
sentences.zh: 现在他出来了，并决心不再得病。

sentences.en: So when he goes out on the town, he wears what he calls armour, i.e. a kind of primitive condom.
sentences.zh: 所以当他去城里时，他戴着他所谓的“盔甲”，即一种原始的避孕套。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And he's roaming St. James's Park where all the most glamorous prostitutes are to be picked up on the Haymarket.
sentences.zh: 他在圣詹姆斯公园游荡，那里有最迷人的妓女，可以在干草市场接客。

sentences.en: And on one occasion, he actually takes a girl from the Haymarket down to Westminster Bridge simply for the excitement of having sex with her, with the Thames ruling below us.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他真的从干草市场带了一个女孩到威斯敏斯特桥，仅仅是为了和她发生性关系的刺激，泰晤士河在下面流淌。

sentences.en: He says, it amused me much.
sentences.zh: 他说，这让我很开心。

sentences.en: So he's-
sentences.zh: 所以他——

sentences.en: Easily pleased.
sentences.zh: 很容易满足。

sentences.en: Well, I think a man who likes to spice up his pleasures in all kinds of strange ways.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想一个喜欢以各种奇怪方式为自己的快乐增添情趣的人就是这样。

sentences.en: But this is a kind of index of his unhappiness.
sentences.zh: 但这其实是他内心痛苦的一种体现。

sentences.en: And he's depressed as well, not just that he's sinking into kind of dissipation, as he puts it.
sentences.zh: 而且他不仅陷入了自称的那种放荡生活，还感到非常抑郁。

sentences.en: I mean, he doesn't feel great about what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他对自己所做的一切并不感到自豪。

sentences.en: He's still doing it, but he doesn't feel great about it.
sentences.zh: 他虽然还在继续，但心里并不好受。

sentences.en: But he's depressed as well that he has failed to secure a commission in the guards.
sentences.zh: 而且他因为没能获得皇家卫队的委任状而感到沮丧。

sentences.en: You know, he's not going to be tassing around in a red coat.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他没法穿着红外套招摇过市了。

sentences.en: And this means essentially that he is going to have to pursue a career in the law, which is what his father had always intended for him.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他基本上必须去从事法律职业，这也是他父亲一直为他规划的道路。

sentences.en: And so he's highly suspicious that it is Lord Affleck, his father, who has pulled strings and denied him his chance to be in the guards.
sentences.zh: 所以他非常怀疑是他的父亲阿弗莱克勋爵在背后搞鬼，断送了他进入卫队的机会。

sentences.en: And this is what sets the scene for the meeting with Samuel Johnson that we described at the beginning of the last episode.
sentences.zh: 这为我们上一集开头提到的与塞缪尔·约翰逊的会面埋下了伏笔。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is the moment to which he's looked forward for so long.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是他期待已久的时刻。

sentences.en: But actually, that foul fiend is still on his shoulder, right?
sentences.zh: 但实际上，那个邪恶的念头依然如影随形，对吧？

sentences.en: Because just after he meets Johnson, he's back out on the streets and he's forgotten his armour.
sentences.zh: 因为就在他见过约翰逊之后，他又回到了街上，把自己的盔甲忘得一干二净。

sentences.en: Paul from Boswell.
sentences.zh: 保罗，关于鲍斯韦尔。

sentences.en: It doesn't stop him.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有阻止他。

sentences.en: So, you know, he's playing riskily.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他在冒险。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But it's clear, I think, that despite this, or maybe because of this, he's still very keen to have Johnson's advice, his friendship, and above all, I think, his moral guidance.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很明显，尽管如此，或者也许正因如此，他仍然非常渴望得到约翰逊的建议、友谊，最重要的是，我认为，还有他的道德指引。

sentences.en: And although Johnson had been quite bearish with him, you know, he'd been very rude about him being Scottish and so on.
sentences.zh: 虽然约翰逊对他相当冷淡，你知道，还对他身为苏格兰人等等表现得非常粗鲁。

sentences.en: Boswell plucks up courage.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔鼓起了勇气。

sentences.en: And one week after his first meeting with Johnson, he goes to meet the great man in his chambers in a temple lane.
sentences.zh: 在第一次见到约翰逊一周后，他前往圣殿巷的寓所拜访这位伟人。

sentences.en: And Boswell has a brilliant description of how Johnson received him.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔对约翰逊接待他的方式有一段精彩的描述。

sentences.en: He received me very courteously, but it must be confessed that his apartment and furniture and morning dress were sufficiently uncouth.
sentences.zh: 他非常有礼貌地接待了我，但必须承认，他的公寓、家具和晨装都相当粗陋。

sentences.en: His brown suit of clothes looked very rusty.
sentences.zh: 他那套棕色西装看起来非常破旧。

sentences.en: He had on a little old shriveled and powdered wig, which was too small for his head.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一顶又小又旧、皱巴巴且扑了粉的假发，对他来说太小了。

sentences.en: His shirt neck and knees of his breeches were loose, his black worsted stockings ill-drawn up, and he had a pair of unbuckled shoes by way of slippers.
sentences.zh: 他的衬衫领口和马裤膝盖处都很松垮，黑色精纺长袜也没穿好，还穿着一双没扣扣子的鞋当拖鞋。

sentences.en: But all these slovenly particularities were forgotten the moment that he began to talk.
sentences.zh: 但当他开始说话时，所有这些邋遢的细节都被抛诸脑后了。

sentences.en: So he dresses like Boris Johnson, actually, sort of slovenly, almost ostentatiously slovenly.
sentences.zh: 所以他穿得就像鲍里斯·约翰逊一样，实际上，那种邋遢，几乎是刻意显摆的邋遢。

sentences.en: But actually, the more that Boswell goes to see him, the slovenliness is overlooked.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，鲍斯韦尔越是去见他，就越会忽略这种邋遢。

sentences.en: He really falls in love with Johnson, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 他真的爱上了约翰逊，不是吗？

sentences.en: Don't you think?
sentences.zh: 你不觉得吗？

sentences.en: I mean, he was primed for it before he went.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在去之前就已经做好准备了。

sentences.en: But he becomes, you know, he starts to think, actually, Johnson really does like me.
sentences.zh: 但他开始觉得，实际上，约翰逊确实很喜欢我。

sentences.en: He's giving him maybe a bit less, maybe some of the barbs about Scotland have a little less
sentences.zh: 他给他的评价可能少了一些，也许那些关于苏格兰的尖刻言辞少了一点

sentences.en: poison than they did beforehand.
sentences.zh: 毒性，不像以前那么重了。

sentences.en: I mean, the barbs continue.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，尖刻的言辞还在继续。

sentences.en: I think what Boswell does feel that Johnson likes him, and Indy Calls Johnson will say this specifically, but I think there's the kind of the magic of Johnson's conversation.
sentences.zh: 我认为鲍斯韦尔确实感觉到约翰逊喜欢他，而且约翰逊本人也会明确提到这一点，但我认为这其中有一种约翰逊谈话的魔力。

sentences.en: And Boswell finds in Johnson a kind of a great champion of conversation.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔在约翰逊身上发现了一种伟大的谈话大师。

sentences.en: It's like watching a tremendous sports star taking on all comers.
sentences.zh: 就像看着一位了不起的体育明星挑战所有对手一样。

sentences.en: And that, I think, is a crucial part of the thrill of it for Boswell.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这对鲍斯韦尔来说是这种快感的关键部分。

sentences.en: So he's, you know, he gives a couple of instances of Johnson's conversation, kind of the early meetings, which illustrates this.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他举了几个约翰逊谈话的例子，也就是早期的几次会面，很好地说明了这一点。

sentences.en: So on one occasion, there's a critic who's written a bad review of a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一位评论家对一部悲剧写了篇糟糕的评论。

sentences.en: And the critic is saying, ah, well, actually, maybe I shouldn't have given the bad review, because who am I?
sentences.zh: 那位评论家说，啊，好吧，其实我可能不该写那篇差评，因为我算什么呢？

sentences.en: I can't write a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 我又写不出悲剧。

sentences.en: And Johnson's very contemptuous of this.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊对此非常轻蔑。

sentences.en: Why no, sir, this is not just reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢，先生，这不仅仅是推理。

sentences.en: You may abuse a tragedy, though you cannot write one.
sentences.zh: 你可以抨击一部悲剧，尽管你写不出一部来。

sentences.en: You may scold a carpenter who has made you a bad table, though you cannot make a table.
sentences.zh: 你可以责骂一个给你做了一张烂桌子的木匠，尽管你不会做桌子。

sentences.en: It is not your trade to make tables.
sentences.zh: 做桌子不是你的职业。

sentences.en: It's not wrong.
sentences.zh: 这没错。

sentences.en: That's the critic flattened.
sentences.zh: 那位评论家被驳得哑口无言。

sentences.en: And then there's another Scott, not Boswell, who is talking to Johnson, but Boswell is listening.
sentences.zh: 然后还有另一个苏格兰人，不是鲍斯韦尔，他在和约翰逊谈话，但鲍斯韦尔在听。

sentences.en: And this Scott insists that his country had many noble prospects.
sentences.zh: 那个苏格兰人坚持说他的国家有很多高尚的前景。

sentences.en: And Johnson comes back, sir, let me tell you the noblest prospect which a Scotchman ever sees is the high road that leads him to England.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊反驳道，先生，让我告诉你，苏格兰人所能见到的最高尚的前景，就是通往英格兰的大路。

sentences.en: And Boswell writes, this unexpected and pointed Sally produced a roar of applause.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔写道，这句出人意料且尖锐的俏皮话引来了一阵欢呼。

sentences.en: This is tremendous banter.
sentences.zh: 这真是绝妙的调侃。

sentences.en: Massive banter.
sentences.zh: 极其精彩的调侃。

sentences.en: But this makes the fact that Johnson seems to like Boswell all the more kind of glorious for
sentences.zh: 但这让约翰逊似乎喜欢鲍斯韦尔这一事实，对鲍斯韦尔来说显得更加辉煌。

sentences.en: Boswell.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔。

sentences.en: And Johnson starts to give him exactly the kind of comfort and moral guidance that Boswell had been looking for.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊开始给他提供鲍斯韦尔一直寻找的那种安慰和道德指引。

sentences.en: So Boswell gets evicted from his rooms in Downing Street because he's been having a late night party.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔因为深夜聚会被赶出了唐宁街的房间。

sentences.en: And Johnson, unlike Lord Affleck, would have torn his head off at this.
sentences.zh: 而约翰逊，不像阿弗莱克勋爵那样，会因此大发雷霆。

sentences.en: Johnson doesn't.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊没有。

sentences.en: He says, consider, sir, how insignificant this will appear a 12-month hence.
sentences.zh: 他说，考虑一下，先生，一年后这看起来会是多么微不足道。

sentences.en: It's good advice.
sentences.zh: 这是很好的建议。

sentences.en: I mean, it's such good advice.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真是很好的建议。

sentences.en: It's such good advice.
sentences.zh: 这真是很好的建议。

sentences.en: And then when, in due course, Lord Affleck says, you are going to become a lawyer to his
sentences.zh: 后来，当阿弗莱克勋爵说，你要成为一名律师时，鲍斯韦尔说，好的，但我可以去低地国家的乌得勒支学习法律吗？

sentences.en: son and Boswell says, OK, but maybe could I go and study law in Utrecht in the Low Countries?
sentences.zh: 阿弗莱克勋爵说，好的，我可以出钱让你去。

sentences.en: And Lord Affleck says, yes, OK, I'll pay you to do that.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔起初对此感到很高兴。

sentences.en: And Boswell's kind of initially happy about this.
sentences.zh: 但随后他开始担心，乌得勒支会不会很无聊？

sentences.en: But then he starts to worry, isn't Utrecht going to be very boring?
sentences.zh: 他将不得不离开伦敦。

sentences.en: He's going to have to leave London.
sentences.zh: 他将不得不离开约翰逊博士。

sentences.en: He's going to have to leave Dr. Johnson.
sentences.zh: 他真的为此变得相当沮丧。

sentences.en: And he really becomes quite depressed about this.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊察觉到了这一点。

sentences.en: And Johnson recognises it.
sentences.zh: 因为他知道他们两人即将分离，他建议去格林威治旅行，也就是顺流而下离开伦敦。

sentences.en: And because he knows that the two of them are going to have to part, he suggests a trip to
sentences.zh: 他们坐上一条船，不停地交谈。

sentences.en: Greenwich, so downriver from London.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔对这一天的完整描述非常精彩。

sentences.en: And they take a boat and they talk and they talk and they talk.
sentences.zh: 我就挑几个重点来说。

sentences.en: Boswell's entire description of this day is wonderful.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论学习是否重要。

sentences.en: But just to give some highlights from it.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔说，当然，每个人都应该学习。

sentences.en: So they're talking about whether learning matters.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊说，嗯，你知道，有很多人工作并不需要学习。

sentences.en: Boswell says, of course, everybody should learn.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这对他们有什么影响。

sentences.en: And Johnson says, well, you know, there are lots of people who don't need learning for their job.
sentences.zh: 然后他转向那个划船的男孩。

sentences.en: I don't think that it matters to them at all.
sentences.zh: 他说，这个男孩划船划得很好，即使他不懂学习，就像他能为最早的水手阿尔戈英雄唱俄耳甫斯的歌一样。

sentences.en: And he then turns to the boy who is rowing them in the boat.
sentences.zh: 所以他不需要了解伊阿宋和阿尔戈英雄就能划船。

sentences.en: And he says, this boy rose us as well without learning as if he could sing the song of Orpheus to the Argonauts who were the first sailors.
sentences.zh: 然后他叫住那个男孩。

sentences.en: So he doesn't need to know about Jason and the Argonauts to row the boat.
sentences.zh: 小伙子，你愿意用什么来换取关于阿尔戈英雄的知识？

sentences.en: He then called to the boy.
sentences.zh: 先生，男孩说，我愿意付出我所拥有的一切。

sentences.en: What would you give my lad to know about the Argonauts?
sentences.zh: 这与约翰逊刚才的论点相矛盾。

sentences.en: Sir, said the boy, I would give what I have.
sentences.zh: 但鲍斯韦尔说约翰逊对他的回答非常满意。

sentences.en: Now that's contradicting what Johnson had argued.
sentences.zh: 我们给了他双倍的车费。

sentences.en: But Boswell says Johnson was much pleased with his answer.
sentences.zh: 所以约翰逊很喜欢人们对学习希腊神话有胃口，即使是在伦敦的出租船上也是如此。

sentences.en: And we gave him a double fare.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得格林威治怎么样？

sentences.en: So Johnson loves the fact that there is an appetite for learning about Greek mythology,
sentences.zh: 他们其实有点失望，不是吗？

sentences.en: even on the, you know, the taxi boats of London.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，他们只是在公园里散步，两人都认为那里非常美丽。

sentences.en: And what do they make of Greenwich?
sentences.zh: 当约翰逊问鲍斯韦尔，你知道，这不是很棒吗？

sentences.en: They're actually slightly underwhelmed, no?
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔回答说，是的，先生，但比不上舰队街。

sentences.en: Well, no, they kind of walk in the park and they both agree that it's very beautiful.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊说，你说得对，先生。

sentences.en: When Johnson asked Boswell, you know, is it not very fine?
sentences.zh: 约翰逊更喜欢熙熙攘攘的大道，而不是那种，你知道，一堆树木。

sentences.en: Boswell answers, yes, sir, but not equal of Fleet Street.
sentences.zh: 他们回来得很晚，玩得很开心，以至于鲍斯韦尔一路上都在发抖，因为，你知道，天气很冷。

sentences.en: And Johnson says, you are right, sir.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊那强健的体魄一点也没受寒冷影响，他责骂我，好像我的颤抖是一种卑微的软弱。

sentences.en: Johnson much prefers a bustling thoroughfare to a kind of, you know, a load of trees.
sentences.zh: 他们回到伦敦，前往河岸街，最后在土耳其头咖啡馆落脚。

sentences.en: And they return so late in the evening, they've been having such a great time, that Boswell shivers the whole way because, you know, it's quite cold.
sentences.zh: 他们还在交谈，此时，鲍斯韦尔觉得他已经准备好与约翰逊分享各种亲密和秘密了。

sentences.en: Johnson, whose robust frame was not in the least affected by the cold, scalded me as if my shivering had been a paltry effeminacy.
sentences.zh: 于是他告诉他关于阿弗莱克城堡的事，约翰逊说有一天他会去看看。

sentences.en: They arrive back in London, they head to the Strand, and they end up at the Turks Head coffeehouse.
sentences.zh: 然后他们越来越多地谈论，你知道，即将到来的离别。

sentences.en: They're still talking, and by now, Boswell is feeling that he's ready to share all kinds of intimacies and confidences with Johnson.
sentences.zh: 鲍斯韦尔显然非常非常不舍得离开。

sentences.en: And so he tells him about the castle at Affleck, and Johnson says one day that he will see it.
sentences.zh: 他很紧张。

sentences.en: And they then talk more and more about, you know, the looming departure.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊说，我必须送你离开英格兰。

sentences.en: Boswell is clearly very, very unhappy to be leaving.
sentences.zh: 我会陪你去哈里奇。

sentences.en: He's nervous.
sentences.zh: 哈里奇是他将乘船前往低地国家的地方。

sentences.en: And Johnson says, I must see thee out of England.
sentences.zh: 正如鲍斯韦尔完全意识到的那样，这是一种极高的荣誉标志。

sentences.en: I will accompany you to Harwich.
sentences.zh: 这不是约翰逊通常会做的事情。

sentences.en: And Harwich is where he'll be sailing up to the Low Countries.

sentences.en: Yes.
